_doc: Superseded readings — do not resurrect. Each entry is a regex the claim linter (llmopt/lab/claimlint.py) refuses in NEW verdict/analysis prose, with the booked correction that killed it. Add entries when a reading correction books; never delete one (the registry is provenance, like RIFF-LEDGER). Historical ledger text is NOT linted — only new drafts. Optional per-rule 'scope': a regex; the rule fires as ERROR only when the draft matches it (thread-scoped readings); scopeless rules are global.

deny.reason: Refuted by own data: private D at r=296 captures 4.678x the random baseline — individual experts are substantially anisotropic.

Misalignment is the leading CANDIDATE, not measured. Efficiency at different ranks does not measure alignment (synthetic 1/i spectrum with no coordinate change reproduces a ~3x efficiency gap). Pending the C@296-v-D@296 rider and the overlap census.
No distribution was measured. E's 1.067x capture proxy is 'close to random expectation', nothing stronger.
E IS the registered gauge-control arm — convergent post-hoc evidence from the same arm, never independent. Independence requires a distinct registered source.
No admissible scalar contrast exists in STREAM-WDISTILL-0: arm A serialized 19 bytes over B1. Scalar wording stays descriptive — never 'matched bytes', 'winner', or 'loses'.
Booked overclaim: the k-means stage is Lloyd-ITERATED, not optimal; no optimality certificate exists.
Efficiency ratios at different ranks carry a rank-position confound; a structure multiple between arms at unequal rank is not a measured quantity.
RUN_TAG is a mitigation only. The frozen-receipt invariant is the content-addressed lock (docs/receipts.lock.json) plus CI refusal.
RK-CENSUS reconstruction references are HEURISTIC selections (teacher-top-|z|, contribution-ranked), not exact subset optima; the exact optimum is unmeasured.
X is measured on the corpus surface and K on prefixes; the io split confounds metric with evaluation surface. Say corpus-X / prefix-K recovery.
Raw top1-top2 logit margin is not geometric distance to the decision boundary ((z_y-z_j)/||w_y-w_j||, needs head row norms). Corrected by AMENDMENT QWEN-LOOP-STATE-0-COLOR2 (2026-08-20).
Greedy decoding is deterministic; the sampling framing was wrong. Corrected reading: the deterministic correction policy itself substantially repeats (AMENDMENT QWEN-LOOP-STATE-0-COLOR2, 2026-08-20).
HEADSWAP was an offline conditional read of frozen h_BLe, not an online causal replacement; only the LOCAL/static reading is supported. Corrected by AMENDMENT QWEN-LOOP-STATE-1-SCOPE (2026-08-20).
Supported only as a local/static claim on frozen BLe states; trajectory-level readout causality open. Corrected by AMENDMENT QWEN-LOOP-STATE-1-SCOPE (2026-08-20).

Cumulative first-N reading; equal-width windowed adjudication (rider3) shows the thinking topic contrast peaks in window 9:16 then declines. Surviving claim is the early-horizon regime difference only. Corrected by AMENDMENT GRF-NOTHINK-0-WINDOWS (2026-08-21).
The beyond-frequency AUC component is U-shaped in H, largest at H<=4; what grows with H is the popularity-dominated FULL-AGE delta. Corrected by AMENDMENT ROUTE-TIME-0-ISOLATION (2026-08-21).

deny.reason: EX6-TEMPORAL arms are matched on temporal-call dose only; realized routing displacement differs ~2.1x (z1 excluded mass 1.82% v 0.86-0.88% at z2/z3). Say 'identical temporal-call dose'.

Pooled additivity residual 0 hides per-level residuals L1 -6 / L2 +1 / L3 +5 that cancel. Say 'no registered large pooled NET interaction (|I|<14)'; difficulty-dependent interaction/cancellation open.

B43/B46 matched displaced-SLOT COUNT only; B43 removes the rank-0 expert (359/360) while B46 removes ranks 2-7 — removed router mass and |delta| unmeasured. delta_43 is the NET post-MoE rerouting delta (deleted + entrant + renormalization terms), not one expert's output direction.

T4 corrected: the PERFECT bar is LITERAL (40/40 observed ACTIVE-ONLINE solves); reachability is interpretation/ceiling evidence, never a prerequisite. Encodability full-grain figure is 110/725 actions (15.2%) with a third char class (fresnelc); the L4-5 16.5% child figure is superseded.

That count's booked criterion was encodability only (vocab-complete). The registered stock-eligibility criterion is joint (encodes AND fits ctx<=512): measured joint = 16/101, equal on this corpus by co-occurrence, not identity. Name the criterion when quoting the number; >512 is outside the trained/registered context contract, not physically unscorable.

MicroLM's cached path is causal only at T=1 (is_causal=False whenever past is set): chunked cached scoring leaks future child tokens, so cached and full conditionals are NOT established identical (qualification registered, unrun). Runtime dominance was a position-count argument ignoring O(T^2) attention; retracted pending the measured microbench.
